comment: Sane shop states under the sanity_check option: a debug-mode Valkyrie level-teleports to Minetown, detects objects, teleports beside Izchak's lighting store, picks up an unpaid candle, drops her dagger (no_charge), puts the candle in a wished bag and drops the bag on the shop floor. mkobj.c shop_obj_sanity() (no other recording enters it) runs on each state and C prints no sanity_check() message. Seed, date, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
